How I think about products

Every case study follows the same flow.

1 ProblemWho is struggling, and what are they trying to do?
2 InsightWhat is the real cause behind the symptom?
3 DecisionWhich solution wins, and what do we leave out?
4 ValidateTest with people, check clarity, then iterate.

What I do

Design that starts with the problem and ends with a clear interface.

Product designFrame the problem, define the flow, and design what ships.
UI designClean, accessible interfaces for mobile apps and the web.
UX flowsUser journeys, wireframes, and decisions that make sense.
PrototypingInteractive Figma prototypes to test ideas early.

Photography shapes how I design

Photography is the other half of my craft. I spent over a year working with a photography studio, learning light, framing, color, and how to direct attention. I bring the same eye to interfaces: clear focal points, honest contrast, and details that earn their place.

My photography on Instagram: @imagen__studios

Designing with clarity and care

I'm Adejumo Ifeoluwa, a Nigerian product designer and photographer. I care about how things work and how they feel. I turn messy problems into simple, clear interfaces, and a year-plus at a photography studio trained my eye for composition, color, and detail. I'm open to product design opportunities, remote or on-site.
